verdict.rationale: Figma documents a first-party plugin system that users and organizations use to customize and automate their workflows, including bringing in outside content such as stock photos. A community user confirms using a bulk export plugin. The evidence never documents a public plugin community or marketplace, its size, or the specific plugin categories the story names. Missing for 10: evidence of a public plugin marketplace or community and its scale, documented icon, data-filler or accessibility-checker plugins, and independent corroboration of the plugin ecosystem's breadth.

support.subject: As a designer, I can extend the editor from a large plugin community or marketplace — icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers, and more

citations.quote: Users and organizations take advantage of plugins to customize their experience and create more efficient workflows.
Automate tasks, add new functionality, and improve your workflow with plugins for everything from documentation to communication.
Bring outside content like stock photos into Figma
Also used a bulk export plugin that autonames things.
